name: manapos
description: Professional desktop Point of Sale application for Windows.
author: ManaPOS

scripts.setup: npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run install:sqlite && npm run install:electron
scripts.install:sqlite: cd node_modules/better-sqlite3 && npx -y prebuild-install -r electron -t 36.0.0 --arch x64
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.start: npm run build && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
